assessments.reasoning: MS-VBAL v20250520 §5.2.1.3 independently specifies both directions of the claim. Presence of Option Explicit selects explicit declaration mode for the containing module. Omission selects implicit mode for that module.

challenge.method: Consider two modules in the same project with the directive in only one. Check whether the second module’s mode follows from an express omission rule.
challenge.results: Each module satisfies a different condition. The static semantics directly assign implicit mode to the module without the directive, without requiring an inference about editor settings or the treatment of a particular variable.

limitations: This claim covers the module mode in the cited edition. It does not infer behavior of editor settings, other languages, or detailed implicit-declaration rules.
